author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Colorist and Procreate Illustrator for Coloring Pages
content: A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY! I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! Please tag someone you know may fit the brief for these positions! I am looking for 2 freelancers.... the work will just be a few hours at first but will definitely grow more and more over time... 1) A COLORIST: I require a colorist who will create a mobile phone video recording of themselves coloring in one of my Viva Chroma Coloring Pages. We will begin with really simple pages and coloring them in glitter. ... 2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR: I require someone creative who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs for me. ... Contact: DM Abbie Cornall on Facebook. Proposed fee required per video and per 5 pages.

author: Kisai Entertainment
title: Your Career with Kisai - Week 2 November: Hiring Artists
content: Your Career with Kisai - Week 2 November. Hai, Kisai Enthusiast! Weekly update lowongan Kisai sudah tayang lagi nih! Kalau kamu siap berkembang, berkarya, dan jadi bagian dari proyek webtoon seru bersama tim Kisai, ini bisa jadi momennya kamu! Kisai sedang mencari: 1. Line Artist 2. Base & Shading Artist 3. Finishing Artist 4. Storyboard Artist 5. Business Development Officer (KY Academy) 6. Business Development Officer (Original IP). Cek semua posisi yang tersedia dan apply di: kisaient.com/careers. Masih ada yang mau ditanyakan? Langsung DM saja ya! Lamaran hanya diterima melalui website resmi Kisai Entertainment. Contact: Apply at kisaient.com/careers or DM.
